note: Paper money only. Claude's daily review may tune these numbers. Demo copies go to demo.kalshi.co only.

data_pot.note: Separate fake $1,000 pot: about $2 on one pseudo-random outcome of every Kalshi game starting in the next 6 hours, all sports. For data (calibration, fees, line movement), never copied to the demo.

other_markets.note: Separate fake $1,000 pot for Kalshi weather (7 cities), crypto (BTC/ETH hourly) and economics (CPI, jobs, Fed). $2 data bets on one random live outcome per event, plus the weather-forecast strategy vs the National Weather Service forecast. Never copied to the demo.

backtest.note: Stock strategy backtests on ~20 years of Yahoo prices, rerun weekly into state/backtest.json.

wild.note: Separate fake $1,000 wildcard pot (state/wild.json): about $1 on one random outcome of each liquid Kalshi event the other pots don't cover (pop culture, AI/tech, gas, TSA, weather extras, mentions, sports props). Least-covered categories first, max 3 new per category per run. Never copied to the demo.

parlays.note: Separate fake $500 parlay pot (state/parlay.json): keeps running totals for every traded+settled Kalshi combo (what buyers at the last trade price got back, by legs, same-game vs mixed, and topic; a 10% sample of rows goes to data/parlays/), and places ~$1 paper bets on combos real buyers just bought (public trade feed) at the price they paid, balanced across 2-3 / 4-6 / 7+ legs and same-game / mixed. Never copied to the demo.
